toolCalls.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r'C:\Users\liuliu\Documents\tura_workspace\target\project-rebuild-source-port\r-be0958c180\eza\tura-direct-1\workspace')
work = root / 'rust-reference'
official = Path(r'C:\Users\liuliu\Documents\tura_workspace\target\project-rebuild-source-port\_cache\binaries\eza\v0.23.3\eza.exe')
port = root / 'executable'
cases = [
 ['tests/itest'], ['-1','tests/itest'], ['--icons=always','tests/itest'],
 ['--classify=always','tests/itest'], ['--only-dirs','tests/itest'], ['--only-files','tests/itest'],
 ['-T','tests/itest'], ['tests/itest/index.svg','--absolute'],
 ['tests/test_dir','--long','--no-user','--no-time','--no-filesize','--no-permissions'],
]
failed=[]
for args in cases:
    o = subprocess.run([str(official), *args], cwd=work, capture_output=True)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(port), *args], cwd=work, capture_output=True)
    if (o.returncode,o.stdout,o.stderr)!=(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr):
        failed.append((args,o,p))
if failed:
    for args,o,p in failed[:5]:
        print('FAIL', args)
        print('official', o.returncode, repr(o.stdout[:300]), repr(o.stderr[:200]))
        print('port    ', p.returncode, repr(p.stdout[:300]), repr(p.stderr[:200]))
    raise SystemExit(1)
print('ok: selected original fixture differential cases matched')
PY
